why: CmuxEgress (Packages/Shared/CmuxEgress) is the Swift half of the egress gate docs/privacy.md describes. Its one lock-guarded state (CmuxEgress.state: mode override, hosts the person named, hosts already logged, the shared gated sessions) must be process-wide: the check that catches every request and redirect hop is URLProtocol.canInit(with:), a class method URLSession calls with no instance to inject a gate into, and the mode is read from CMUX_EGRESS once per process. Passing a gate through the 64 calling files would move the same global behind a parameter. The Rust crate cmux-egress keeps the same state global.
